messages:
Maya (PM): quick sync — we need agreement on guardrails for pinning + customer cutover. major enterprise customer asking for 'no surprise' behavior and an escape hatch :exclamation:
Oliver (Eng): can you clarify asks? is this about pinned model version vs auto-upgrades?
Maya (PM): yep. two things: 1) customers can pin to a catalog version for X weeks, 2) in emergencies they want an automated rollback/escape path and comm windows.
Jess (Solutions): from field: customers want a short SLA for rollback (<=4h) and a visible “pending-deprecation” flag in API responses. helps ops + app teams.
Sam (CS): also hearing they want notice windows and an opt-in migration path with telemetry on quality regressions. legal wants opt-in recorded.
Oliver (Eng): implementation notes — we can add a pin TTL, and a ``soft-deprecate`` state that blocks auto-swap. rollback flow: route traffic -> previous pinned commit -> canary for 30m -> full swap.
Oliver (Eng): minimal config sketch: ```
{ "pin": "v2.3.0", "pin_ttl_days": 30, "soft_deprecate": true, "rollback_window_hours": 4 }
```
Jess (Solutions): that looks good. question: how do we surface the flag in responses? header? structured metadata? customers prefer structured JSON field.
Maya (PM): structured metadata + console banner. Also add an API field `model_status: [active|soft_deprecate|deprecated]` in responses.
Sam (CS): what are launch gates? customers will require runbooks and a dry-run migration for their tenant.
Oliver (Eng): propose gates: unit perf tests, benchmark parity (within 2% latency and ±3% RLHF-style metric), and a customer dry-run pass.
Jess (Solutions): we should publish an acceptance checklist for customers (steps + expected metrics). I'll draft.
Maya (PM): owners: Eng for runtime changes (Oliver), DevEx for API + console (Jess), CS for customer comms + dry-run coordination (Sam). target: gated beta with 3 customers in 6 weeks.
release-bot: Canary created for catalog v2.3.0 on infra-dedicated-3 :rocket:
Oliver (Eng): note — we need telemetry hooks to detect quality regressions automatically so rollback can be suggested, not just manual. I'll open a PR for metrics.
Maya (PM): good. next: Jess to draft customer checklist, Oliver to spec API fields + PR, Sam to line up two early customers for dry-run. sync Friday EOD?
Jess (Solutions): ack, will share draft by Thu noon.
Sam (CS): I'll ping two pilot customers today.
Oliver (Eng): will start the API + telemetry PR today, aim for internal review Wed.
Maya (PM): perfect — if anything urgent ping me. thanks all :thumbsup:
